info.title: Cipi API
info.description:
REST API for Cipi Server Control Panel. Manage Laravel apps (PHP-FPM or optional Octane/FrankenPHP on Cipi 5.0+), domain aliases, www/apex redirects, SSL certificates, and MariaDB/PostgreSQL databases (Cipi 4.8+ multi-engine).

**Authentication:** All endpoints require a Bearer token via the `Authorization` header.
Tokens are managed with `cipi api token create|list|revoke`.

**Async Operations:** Most write operations (create, edit, delete, SSL, alias/www, database create/backup/restore/password) are dispatched as background jobs with `202 Accepted` and a `job_id`. Poll `GET /api/jobs/{id}` to check status (any authenticated token). **Database listing** (`GET /api/dbs`) and **engines** (`GET /api/dbs/engines`) are synchronous. **Server status** (`GET /api/status`) is synchronous (requires `status-view`).

**Sync Validation:** Domain and app existence checks are performed synchronously before job dispatch. Validation errors (409, 404, 422) are returned immediately.

**Env / auth.json / Artisan (Cipi >= 5.0.3):** `GET|PUT /apps/{name}/env` (key/value, ability `apps-env`), `GET|POST|PUT|DELETE /apps/{name}/auth` (shared auth.json, ability `apps-auth` — not HTTP Basic Auth), `POST /apps/{name}/artisan` (async job, ability `apps-artisan`; poll `GET /jobs/{id}` for output).

**App run (Cipi >= 5.0.3):** `GET /run-commands` and `POST /apps/{name}/run` (ability `apps-run`) dispatch whitelisted non-interactive binaries as the app user (composer, npm, ls, rm, git, … — no nano/vim/less/bash/tinker). Async job; poll `/jobs/{id}`.

**Deploy config (Cipi >= 5.0.3):** `GET|PUT /apps/{name}/deploy-config` (ability `apps-deploy-config`) — structured recipe options (keep_releases, migrate/optimize hooks, node_build, extra_artisan). Regenerates deploy.php from template; not a raw PHP upload.

**MCP Server:** Available at `/mcp` with `mcp-access` ability.

**IP whitelist (Cipi >= 5.0.8):** `GET|PUT|POST|DELETE /ip-whitelist` and `POST /ip-whitelist/allow-all` (abilities `ip-whitelist-view` / `ip-whitelist-manage`). Default `*` allows all clients; otherwise only listed IPv4/IPv6/CIDR may call the API/MCP. Managed on the host with `cipi api ip-whitelist`.

**App/path redirects & prefix proxies (Cipi >= 5.3.1, API sudoers >= 5.4.1):** `GET /apps/{name}/redirects`, `PUT|DELETE /apps/{name}/redirect`, `POST /apps/{name}/redirect/enable|disable`, `POST|DELETE /apps/{name}/redirects` (abilities `redirects-view` / `redirects-manage`); `GET|POST|DELETE /apps/{name}/proxies` (abilities `proxies-view` / `proxies-manage`). Synchronous: the CLI regenerates the vhost, runs `nginx -t` and reverts on failure.

**Node apps & runtimes (Cipi >= 5.4.0):** app create/edit accept `node` (spa|static|ssr), `framework`, `node_version`, `build`, `start`, `output`, `health_path`. `GET /node` lists runtimes, `GET /apps/{name}/node` shows app Node status, `POST /apps/{name}/node/restart` does a blue/green restart (abilities `node-view` / `node-manage`).

**Deploy audit (Cipi >= 5.4.0):** `GET /apps/{name}/deploy/audit` returns the root-only hash-chained ledger records (ability `deploy-manage`).

**Search / Meilisearch (Cipi >= 5.2.2):** `GET /search` (ability `search-view`), `POST /apps/{name}/search/enable|disable` (ability `search-manage`). Engine install/upgrade/key-rotate stay on the host CLI.

**Read-only host insights:** `GET /packages` (`packages-view`, Cipi >= 5.2.2), `GET /monitor` (`monitor-view`, Cipi >= 5.3.0), `GET /zt` (`zt-view`, Cipi >= 5.3.0).

**Fix permissions (Cipi >= 5.2.1):** `POST /apps/{name}/fix-permissions` (ability `apps-edit`) restores the app home permission model as an async job.

**Wildcard domains (Cipi >= 5.1.1):** `*.example.com` is accepted as primary domain on app create/edit.

get.description: List all apps on the server. Requires `apps-view` ability. Returns data synchronously.

post.description:
Create a new app. Validates domain/username synchronously (returns 409/422 on conflict). Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `apps-create` ability.

For **Laravel** apps, `repository` is required. Optional `engine` (`mariadb`|`pgsql`) selects the database engine ([Cipi 4.8+](https://cipi.sh/docs/infrastructure#db)). For **custom** apps (`custom: true`), `repository` is optional: omit it (or send empty) to create an SFTP-only site with no Git deploy. When no repository is set, do not send `branch`.

get.description: Show app details. Returns data synchronously. Requires `apps-view` ability.

put.description: Edit an app (PHP version, branch, repository, or primary domain). Validates app exists synchronously; validates domain format and uniqueness (excluding the current app's aliases) before dispatch. Changing the primary domain moves the old one to aliases, updates Nginx, `APP_URL`, webhooks, and re-issues SSL when applicable — requires [Cipi 4.6.2+](https://github.com/cipi-sh/cipi/releases/tag/4.6.2). Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `apps-edit` ability.

delete.description: Permanently delete an app and all associated resources. Validates app exists synchronously. Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `apps-delete` ability.

post.description: Take an app offline without deleting it. Replaces the app's Nginx vhost with a generic static suspension page served as HTTP 503 (HTTPS included). Validates app exists synchronously and returns 409 if the app is already suspended. Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `apps-suspend` ability.

Bring a suspended app back online by restoring its normal Nginx vhost. Validates app exists synchronously and returns 409 if the app is not suspended. Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `apps-suspend` ability.

Restore the app home to the permission model Cipi created it with (`cipi app fix-permissions`): ownership, 750 home, 700 `.ssh`, 640 `shared/.env`, log ACLs, storage 775. Async job (`app-fix-permissions`); poll `GET /api/jobs/{id}`. Requires `apps-edit` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.2.1.

get.description: Show HTTP Basic Auth status for an app (enabled/disabled and configured usernames). Runs `cipi basicauth status` synchronously. Requires `apps-basicauth` ability.

post.description: Protect an app with Nginx HTTP Basic Auth (RFC 7617). Optional `user` and `password`; when `password` is omitted Cipi auto-generates one and returns it once in the response. Regenerates the vhost and re-applies SSL when a certificate exists. Runs `cipi basicauth enable` synchronously. Requires `apps-basicauth` ability.

Remove HTTP Basic Auth from an app and restore the normal Nginx vhost. Validates app exists synchronously and returns 409 if basic auth is not enabled. Runs `cipi basicauth disable` synchronously. Requires `apps-basicauth` ability.

get.description: Return all `.env` key/value pairs for a Laravel app (`cipi app env --show --json`). Custom apps are rejected. Requires `apps-env` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.0.3.

put.description: Merge `.env` keys (`set`) and/or remove keys (`unset`) without replacing the whole file. Requires `apps-env` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.0.3.

get.description: Return the app's shared `auth.json` (Composer / structured credentials). Distinct from HTTP Basic Auth (`/basicauth`). Requires `apps-auth` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.0.3.

post.description: Create `shared/auth.json` with default users array. Pass `force: true` to overwrite. Requires `apps-auth` ability.

put.description: Replace the entire `auth.json` document with the request body (must be valid JSON). Requires `apps-auth` ability.

delete.description: Delete `shared/auth.json` and remove it from Deployer shared_files. Requires `apps-auth` ability.

post.description: Dispatch `cipi app artisan` as a background job. Poll `GET /api/jobs/{id}` for `output` and `exit_code`. Custom apps and `tinker` are rejected. Requires `apps-artisan` ability.

get.description: Return the non-interactive binary whitelist for `POST /apps/{name}/run`. Editors, pagers, shells, and REPLs are excluded. Requires `apps-run` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.0.3.

post.description: Dispatch `cipi app run` as a background job. Only whitelisted non-interactive binaries are accepted (composer, npm, ls, cat, rm, git, php, node, …). No nano/vim/less/bash/tinker/ssh. Poll `GET /api/jobs/{id}` for output. Requires `apps-run` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.0.3.

get.description: Return structured Deployer recipe options for a Laravel app (stored in apps.json, applied to deploy.php). Requires `apps-deploy-config` and Cipi >= 5.0.3.

put.description: Merge structured deploy options and regenerate deploy.php from the Cipi template. Safe alternative to editing PHP by hand. Requires `apps-deploy-config`.

get.description: Read paginated app log snapshots (nginx, PHP-FPM, Laravel, worker, deploy). Page 1 returns the most recent lines; higher pages return progressively older content. Matches [`cipi app logs`](https://cipi.sh/docs/apps#cli-app-logs) paths. Laravel logs are included when the app has `shared/storage/logs` (or for custom apps, all files under `/home/{app}/logs/`). Log text is redacted for common secrets. Requires `apps-view` ability.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Lines per log file per page (max 1000)

get.description: List domain aliases for an app. Returns data synchronously. Requires `aliases-view` ability.

post.description: Add a domain alias to an app. Validates domain is not in use synchronously (returns 409). Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `aliases-create` ability.

delete.description: Remove a domain alias from an app. Validates alias exists synchronously (returns 404). Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `aliases-delete` ability.

get.description: Show www/apex pair and canonical redirect mode for an app (`to-root`, `from-root`, or none). Reads apps.json synchronously. Requires `www-manage` ability. Cipi 4.8+.

post.description: Add the counterpart host (`www.` + apex, or apex when primary is already `www.*`) as an alias. Dispatches async job. Requires `www-manage`. Cipi 4.8+.
Enable 301 redirect `www.domain` → `domain`. Auto-adds the missing alias. Dispatches async job. Requires `www-manage`. Cipi 4.8+.
Enable 301 redirect `domain` → `www.domain`. Auto-adds the missing alias. Dispatches async job. Requires `www-manage`. Cipi 4.8+.
Clear canonical www/apex redirect state for an app. Dispatches async job. Requires `www-manage`. Cipi 4.8+.

get.description: Whole-app redirect and path redirects of an app (`cipi redirect list --json`). Synchronous. Requires `redirects-view` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

post.description: Add (or update) a path redirect (`cipi redirect add`). A `from` ending in `/` is a prefix match: the rest of the request URI is appended to the target (`--no-path` behaviour via `keep_path: false`). `to` is a same-app `/path` or an `http(s)://` URL. Reserved paths (ACME, `/cipi/webhook`, Reverb, `/index.php`, ...) and colliding rules are refused by the CLI. Synchronous with nginx test + revert. Requires `redirects-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

delete.description: Remove a path redirect by its `from` path (`cipi redirect remove`). Requires `redirects-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

put.description: Every hostname of the app (www host included) redirects to the target URL in one hop (`cipi redirect set`). Path and query are kept by default (`keep_path`). ACME stays public so certificates keep renewing; a target served by the app itself is refused (loop). Path redirects and proxies keep working (more specific than `location /`). Requires `redirects-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

delete.description: Remove the whole-app redirect and forget its target (`cipi redirect unset`). Requires `redirects-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

post.description: `cipi redirect enable` — toggles the saved redirect without forgetting its target. Requires `redirects-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.
`cipi redirect disable` — toggles the saved redirect without forgetting its target. Requires `redirects-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

get.description: Prefix reverse proxies of an app (`cipi proxy list --json`). Synchronous. Requires `proxies-view` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

post.description: Add (or update) a reverse proxy on a path prefix (`cipi proxy add`): `location ^~ <prefix>` with `proxy_pass`, WebSocket upgrade, `X-Real-IP` / `X-Forwarded-*` and `proxy_ssl_server_name` for HTTPS upstreams. An upstream with a path requires `strip_prefix: true`. The CLI loopback guard is never bypassed from the API: proxies to 127.0.0.1 ports Cipi already uses (nginx, SSH, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Valkey, Meilisearch, other apps’ Octane/Reverb) are refused. Synchronous with nginx test + revert. Requires `proxies-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

delete.description: Remove the proxy on a prefix (`cipi proxy remove`). Requires `proxies-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

post.description: Trigger a deploy for an app. Validates app exists synchronously. Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `deploy-manage` ability.
Rollback the last deploy of an app. Validates app exists synchronously. Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `deploy-manage` ability.
Unlock a stuck deploy for an app. Validates app exists synchronously. Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `deploy-manage` ability.

get.description: Deploy audit records for the app (`cipi deploy <app> --audit --json`): one record per deploy event (published / failed / rollback), whatever started it — CLI, panel, webhook, SSH, cron — with origin, operator, IP and `claimed` metadata from the root-only hash-chained ledger. Empty list when the ledger does not exist yet. Query `days` (default 90). Synchronous. Requires `deploy-manage` ability and Cipi 5.4.0+.

post.description: Install Let's Encrypt SSL certificate for an app. Validates app exists synchronously. Dispatches CLI command as async job. Requires `ssl-manage` ability.
Re-apply HTTP → HTTPS redirect for an app that already has a Let's Encrypt certificate (no new issuance). Sets `force_https` in apps.json. Dispatches async job. Requires `ssl-manage`. Cipi 4.8+.

get.description: Poll a background job status. Any authenticated token can check any job (typically after receiving a `job_id` from another endpoint). Returns status (pending, running, completed, failed). When finished, includes `result` (parsed structured data from Cipi CLI) and `output` (raw CLI output).

Returns the same structured data as `cipi status`: system info, resources (CPU, memory, disk), services (nginx, mariadb, optional postgresql when installed, supervisor, fail2ban), PHP pools, and app count. Runs `sudo cipi status` on the host and parses CLI output; falls back to direct host reads when sudo is unavailable. Requires `status-view` ability and `cipi status` in `cipi-api` sudoers (see Cipi `setup.sh`).

Installed Node runtimes with the server default and the apps on each major (`cipi node list`). Installing/removing runtimes and changing the default stay on the host CLI. Requires `node-view` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

Node status from apps.json: mode (spa/static/ssr), framework, Node major, build/start commands, output dir and health path. `node: false` for non-Node apps (with `version` still set when a Laravel app is pinned to a Node major). Requires `node-view` ability and Cipi 5.4.0+.

post.description: Restart an SSR Node app with a blue/green switch — no downtime (`cipi node restart`). Returns 409 for non-Node apps. Async job (`node-restart`); poll `GET /api/jobs/{id}`. Requires `node-manage` ability and Cipi CLI >= 5.4.1.

get.description: Meilisearch (Laravel Scout) status: installed, running, version, health, data size and search-enabled apps (`cipi search status --json`). Requires `search-view` ability and Cipi 5.2.2+.

post.description: Enable Meilisearch for a Laravel app (`cipi search enable`): mints an API key scoped to the `<app>-*` index prefix and writes `SCOUT_*` / `MEILISEARCH_*` into `shared/.env`. Meilisearch must already be installed on the host (`cipi search install` stays with the operator). Returns 422 for custom/Node apps. Requires `search-manage` ability and Cipi 5.2.2+.

Disable Meilisearch for an app (`cipi search disable`): restores the previous `SCOUT_DRIVER` and revokes the app key. Indexes are never purged from the API (root-only `--purge-indexes`). Requires `search-manage` ability and Cipi 5.2.2+.

get.description: Allowlisted optional host packages with install state (`cipi package list --json`): image-optimizers, ffmpeg, imagemagick, poppler-utils, … Read-only: install/remove run as root and stay on the host CLI. Requires `packages-view` ability and Cipi 5.2.2+.

Monitor checks with config, current state and last alert (`cipi monitor list --json`): disk, ssl, services, workers, http_5xx, fs, load. The cron runs every 5 minutes and alerts edge-triggered. Read-only: thresholds and enable/disable stay on the host CLI. Requires `monitor-view` ability and Cipi 5.3.0+.

Cloudflare Zero Trust status (`cipi zt status`): cloudflared/tunnel state, real_ip, HTTP/SSH locks and SSH hostname, plus the raw CLI output. Read-only by design — the API sudoers allow `zt status` only. Requires `zt-view` ability and Cipi 5.3.0+.
Runs `sudo cipi db engines` and returns installed engines (MariaDB / PostgreSQL), ports, and the server-wide default. Synchronous. Requires `dbs-view`. Cipi 4.8+.

Runs `sudo cipi db list` on the server (synchronous). Optional query `engine=mariadb|pgsql` filters to one engine (Cipi 4.8+). Returns engine, name, user, and size when available. Requires `dbs-view`.

503.description: MySQL listing unavailable (wrong DB driver, connection error, or missing privileges)

post.description: Create a database and user. Optional `engine` (`mariadb`|`pgsql`) selects the engine (server default when omitted). Requires Cipi 4.8+ for PostgreSQL. Validates `name` as a Cipi username. Returns 409 if a create job for the same name is already pending. Dispatches async job. Requires `dbs-create`.
Create a compressed SQL backup. Optional `engine` in JSON body (Cipi 4.8+). Dispatches async job. Requires `dbs-manage`.
Restore from a `.sql.gz` backup file path on the server. Optional `engine` (Cipi 4.8+). Dispatches async job. Requires `dbs-manage`.
Regenerate the database user password. Optional `engine` in JSON body (Cipi 4.8+). Dispatches async job. Requires `dbs-manage`.

get.description: Returns allow_all / entries from `/etc/cipi/api-ip-whitelist`, plus the caller `client_ip`. Requires `ip-whitelist-view`. Cipi CLI ≥ 5.0.8.

put.description: Replace the whitelist with `entries` (`*` or IPs/CIDRs). When restricting, the caller IP is auto-added unless `ensure_client_ip` is false. Requires `ip-whitelist-manage`.

post.description: Add one IP or CIDR. Switching from `*` starts restricted mode. Requires `ip-whitelist-manage`.

delete.description: Remove one IP or CIDR. Removing the last entry resets to allow-all (`*`). Requires `ip-whitelist-manage`.

post.description: Reset whitelist to `*`. Requires `ip-whitelist-manage`. Escape hatch if you locked yourself out via API — prefer `cipi api ip-whitelist allow-all` on the host.

BearerAuth.description: Sanctum API token. Create with: cipi api token create

DbName.name: name
DbName.description: Database name (Cipi username rules: lowercase, 3–32 chars)

repository.description: Git repository URL (SSH). Required for Laravel apps; optional for custom apps when using SFTP-only hosting without Git (Cipi 4.4.4+).

branch.description: Git branch when a repository is set. Omit when there is no repository (SFTP-only custom apps).

custom.description: Create a custom (non-Laravel) app with classic deploy. When true, repository may be omitted for SFTP-only sites.

docroot.description: Document root path for custom apps (e.g. dist, public). Default: /

engine.description: Database engine for Laravel apps (ignored for custom apps). Requires Cipi 4.8+ and an installed engine. Server default when omitted.

octane.description: Serve Laravel via Octane (FrankenPHP) instead of PHP-FPM. Requires Cipi 5.0+ and laravel/octane in the app repository. Not compatible with custom apps. Boolean true is equivalent to frankenphp.

node.description: Create a Node frontend app (Cipi 5.4.0+). Not compatible with custom/octane/engine/php. Repository required.

framework.description: Node framework preset (fills mode/build/start/output defaults; explicit fields win)

start.description: Start command for ssr apps (Node runner + args)

output.description: Build output directory for spa/static apps

health_path.description: Health path for ssr apps (blue/green switch checks it)

domain.description: New primary domain. The previous primary becomes an alias; promoting an existing alias to primary is supported. Requires Cipi 4.6.2+.

node.description: Node app mode (Node apps only, Cipi 5.4.0+)

node_version.description: Node major (22, 24, ...). On a Laravel app pins the app to that major; "default" follows the server default again

output.description: Build output directory (spa/static Node apps only)

basic_auth.description: Whether HTTP Basic Auth is enabled on the app vhost

engine.description: App database engine (Laravel apps; null for custom / unset)

www_redirect.description: Canonical www redirect mode (null when none). Cipi 4.8+.

force_https.description: Whether HTTP → HTTPS redirect is forced (set by ssl install/force). Cipi 4.8+.

octane.description: Octane server when the app uses Octane instead of PHP-FPM (null for FPM apps). Cipi 5.0+.

octane_port.description: Localhost port for the Octane process (null for FPM apps). Cipi 5.0+.

node.description: Whether the app is a Node frontend app (Cipi 5.4.0+)

node_mode.description: Node app mode (null for non-Node apps)

node_version.description: Node major (Node apps, or Laravel apps pinned via app edit)

basic_auth.description: Whether HTTP Basic Auth is enabled on the app vhost

engine.description: App database engine (Laravel apps; null for custom / unset)

www_redirect.description: Canonical www redirect mode (null when none). Cipi 4.8+.

force_https.description: Whether HTTP → HTTPS redirect is forced (set by ssl install/force). Cipi 4.8+.

octane.description: Octane server when the app uses Octane instead of PHP-FPM (null for FPM apps). Cipi 5.0+.

octane_port.description: Localhost port for the Octane process (null for FPM apps). Cipi 5.0+.

node.description: Whether the app is a Node frontend app (Cipi 5.4.0+)

node_mode.description: Node app mode (null for non-Node apps)

node_version.description: Node major (Node apps, or Laravel apps pinned via app edit)

warnings.description: Present when high-risk patterns were detected after redaction

password.description: Password (auto-generated when omitted; returned once in the response)
Present only when Cipi auto-generated the password

name.description: Database name (must satisfy Cipi username rules; invalid names return 422 with `{ "error": "..." }`)

engine.description: Database engine (server default when omitted). Cipi 4.8+.

file.description: Path to a `.sql.gz` backup on the server (safe path characters only). Invalid paths return 422 with `{ "error": "..." }`.

job_id.description: Background job UUID. Poll GET /api/jobs/{id} for status.

result.description: Parsed structured result from Cipi CLI (only when status is completed or failed). Structure varies by job type.

output.description: Raw CLI output (only present when status is completed or failed)

exit_code.description: CLI exit code (only present when status is completed or failed)

deploy_key.description: SSH public key for Git (may be absent for SFTP-only custom apps without a repository)

size.description: Human-readable size when reported by CLI

url.description: Connection URL when provided by CLI

JobResultError.description: Result when job failed and parsing could not extract structured data

AuthJsonDocument.description: Arbitrary JSON document stored as shared/auth.json

command.description: Artisan command and arguments (no shell metacharacters; tinker blocked)
Whitelisted binary + args (e.g. composer install --no-dev, ls -la, npm run build)

entries.description: Use `["*"]` for allow-all, or IPv4/IPv6/CIDR entries

ensure_client_ip.description: When true (default), append the caller IP if missing while restricting

AppRedirect.description: Whole-app redirect (null when none is saved)

keep_path.description: Whether the request path and query are appended to the target

from.description: Source path. Ending in / = prefix match

keep_path.description: Keep request path and query on the target

from.description: Source path, written decoded. Ending in / = prefix match (e.g. /blog/)

keep_path.description: For prefix redirects: append the rest of the URI to the target

from.description: Source path of the redirect to remove

prefix.description: Path prefix to proxy (normalized to trailing /)

upstream.description: http(s)://host[:port][/path] — an upstream path requires strip_prefix

strip_prefix.description: Strip the prefix before passing upstream (sends X-Forwarded-Prefix)

preserve_host.description: Send the original Host header instead of the upstream host

buffering.description: false for SSE / long polling / streamed downloads

major.description: Node major, or "system" for the NodeSource package

default.description: Whether this is the server default (cipi node default)

node.description: Whether the app is a Node app

version.description: Node major (also set on Laravel apps pinned to a major)

origin.description: cipi-cli, panel, webhook, app-web, app-queue, ssh, cron or root-shell

claimed.description: App-supplied metadata (source, actor, ip, ref, request_id)

prev_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous ledger line (hash chain)

apps.description: Search-enabled apps keyed by name ({uid, prefix, enabled_at})

last_alert.description: Unix timestamp of the last alert

Conflict.description: Resource conflict (e.g. domain or app already exists, or duplicate pending database create)

ServiceUnavailable.description: Upstream Cipi CLI command failed or is unavailable
